content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit _ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https"} def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() safe_text = html.escape(name, quote=True) # Only allow safe URL schemes to prevent javascript:/data: injection. # Strip control characters and whitespace that browsers ignore in schemes. cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch >= " " and ch != "\x7f") try: parts = urlsplit(cleaned) scheme = parts.scheme.lower() except ValueError: scheme = "" cleaned = "" if scheme in _ALLOWED_SCHEMES and parts.netloc: safe_href = html.escape(cleaned, quote=True) return f'{safe_text}' # Unsafe or invalid URL: render the anchor without a usable link target. return f'{safe_text}'
